evidence.diff: Commit 21c5917 added step 5b: ysDolaV2.setPauser(PAUSER); ysUsdcV2.setPauser(PAUSER); IPauserAdmin(PAUSER).register(ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2). Added PAUSER constant (0x7c5A...) and a _preflight require that Pauser.owner()==OWNER_ADDRESS. NO setPauser call was added for minterV2.

Precondition confirmed live: Pauser.owner()==0xCad1...D0B6==OWNER (register is onlyOwner), Pauser has bytecode. setPauser-before-register ordering is correct (register validates pauser()).
evidence.stillLive: PhusdStableMinter::setPauser is NEVER called in the trace (0 occurrences). minterV2 deploys with pauser==address(0). PhusdStableMinter.pause() requires msg.sender==pauser, so with pauser==0 the minter can NEVER be paused by anyone — exactly the L-01 condition for the minter half. The original L-01 explicitly covers BOTH strategies AND minterV2; only the strategy half is fixed.
